parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for flagging this—I'm sorry for the confusion and inconvenience. I see you were billed twice for the annual plan renewal on May 1, with invoice numbers INV-9031 and INV-9032.

To make sure we reverse the correct charge and confirm the right invoice to keep for your accounting, could you please reply with:
1) Which invoice should be reversed (INV-9031 or INV-9032)?
2) Are both charges completed/posted, or is one pending/failed?
3) The amount charged on each invoice (if available).
4) The account/subscription ID (or the last 4 digits of the card used) so we can match the charges to your account.

Once we have the above, we’ll have our billing team review both transactions and proceed accordingly.
promised_actions: Billing team will review both transactions after you provide the requested details
We will reverse the correct charge based on your confirmation and match the charges to your account
safety_notes: Human review is required; do not confirm reversal outcome or which invoice remains until billing team verifies the transactions.
Do not promise a refund or provide an accounting/legal determination; only state that we will review and proceed based on the provided details.
